title: Melatonin attenuates chronic stress-induced hippocampal inflammatory response and apoptosis by inhibiting ADAM17/TNF-alpha axis.
authors: Zhang, Haiyang; Wei, Mian; Sun, Ning; Wang, Hui; Fan, Honggang
journal: Food and chemical toxicology : an international journal published for the British Industrial Biological Research Association
one_liner_zh: 该文研究褪黑素通过抑制ADAM17/TNF-alpha轴缓解慢性应激诱导的海马炎症与凋亡，属于神经药理学研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模，亦无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Melatonin, as a dietary supplement, has a potent neuroprotective effect and exerts a certain antidepressant effect. This study explored the molecular mechanisms and targets of melatonin on chronic stress-induced hippocampal damage from the perspective of inhibiting inflammatory cytokines release. Our results indicated that melatonin alleviated chronic restraint stress (CRS)-induced inflammatory response and apoptosis, thus improving hippocampal structural damage and subsequent depression-like behaviors in rats. The radar map displayed that the change of TNF-alpha content was the most significant. Meanwhile, correlation analysis showed that TNF-alpha content was highly positively correlated with apoptosis. Molecular autodocking studies suggested that TNF-alpha converting enzyme ADAM17 as a potential target has a priority in docking with melatonin. Molecular mechanism studies indicated that melatonin inhibited CRS-induced activation of the ADAM17/TNF-alpha axis and its downstream proteins p38 and p53 phosphorylation in the hippocampus. Analogously, Both ADAM17 inhibitor TMI-1 and TNF-alpha inhibitor thalidomide relieved the effects of CRS on ADAM17/TNF-alpha axis and its downstream proteins phosphorylation, hippocampal apoptosis, hippocampal inflammatory response, and depression-like behaviors in rats. Altogether, these findings reveal that melatonin relieves CRS-induced inflammatory response and apoptosis, and subsequent depression-like behaviors by inhibiting ADAM17/TNF-alpha axis.
abstract_zh: 褪黑素作为一种膳食补充剂，具有强效的神经保护作用，并发挥一定的抗抑郁效果。本研究从抑制炎症细胞因子释放的角度，探讨了褪黑素对慢性应激诱导的海马损伤的分子机制和靶点。我们的结果表明，褪黑素减轻了慢性束缚应激（CRS）诱导的炎症反应和细胞凋亡，从而改善了大鼠海马结构损伤及随后的抑郁样行为。雷达图显示，TNF-alpha含量的变化最为显著。同时，相关性分析表明，TNF-alpha含量与细胞凋亡高度正相关。分子自动对接研究提示，TNF-alpha转化酶ADAM17作为潜在靶点，在与褪黑素对接时具有优先性。分子机制研究表明，褪黑素抑制了CRS诱导的海马中ADAM17/TNF-alpha轴及其下游蛋白p38和p53磷酸化的激活。类似地，ADAM17抑制剂TMI-1和TNF-alpha抑制剂沙利度胺均缓解了CRS对大鼠ADAM17/TNF-alpha轴及其下游蛋白磷酸化、海马细胞凋亡、海马炎症反应和抑郁样行为的影响。总之，这些发现揭示，褪黑素通过抑制ADAM17/TNF-alpha轴，缓解了CRS诱导的炎症反应和细胞凋亡，以及随后的抑郁样行为。
